title: Allow Azure OpenAI privacy notice in evaluation
summary: Azure OpenAI privacy notice is now treated as approved during evaluation mode unless explicitly declined, while the Expense Agent privacy notice continues to require explicit approval.
key_points: Azure OpenAI privacy notice assumed approved in evaluation unless explicitly declined
Expense Agent privacy notice still requires explicit user approval
Behavior applied consistently to both approval-state checks and confirmation flows
Fixes issue with privacy notice handling during evaluation
quote: Treat the Azure OpenAI privacy notice as approved during evaluation unless it was explicitly declined.
